name: expense-api

dependencies.name: email-service
dependencies.description: Sends the notification emails: to a manager when a claim is submitted, to an employee when it is approved or rejected.

dependencies.name: aws-s3
dependencies.description: Stores receipt files. The API hands out presigned upload and view URLs; file bytes never pass through the API.

description: The single backend for claims, approvals, policy limits, people and payroll exports. It owns all business data in its Postgres database, enforces the rules (submit checks against category maximums and the manager assignment, one decision per claim, export at most once), resolves 'my' and 'my team' rows from the gateway assertion, sends notification emails, and issues presigned receipt URLs. One service because every feature works on the same claim records and is deployed and scaled together; it does not serve the UI, store receipt bytes or sign users in.
